lines.en: Good morning. How is the weather today?
It's cloudy, Grandma. It looks like rain.
lines.ko: 할머니, 흐려요. 비가 올 것 같아요.

lines.en: Yesterday it was sunny and nice.
Yes, we walked in the sun yesterday.
lines.ko: 네, 어제 우리는 햇빛 속에서 걸었어요.

lines.en: Please take your umbrella to school.
Where is my umbrella?
It's by the door. The wind is strong.
Thank you, Grandma. Will it rain all day?
lines.ko: 고마워요, 할머니. 하루 종일 비가 올까요?

lines.en: I think it will rain this afternoon.
Okay. I will come home early.
Hello! Did you hear the weather news this morning?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요! 오늘 아침 날씨 뉴스 들으셨어요?

lines.en: Yes. A storm is coming tonight.
No! We planned a river walk last week.
There will be heavy rain and strong wind.
lines.ko: 비가 많이 오고 바람이 셀 거예요.

lines.en: So let's change the plan. What do you think?
Let's meet at my house. I will make tea.
lines.ko: 우리 집에서 만나요. 제가 차를 끓일게요.

lines.en: That sounds nice. Is Sunday going to be sunny?
Yes, the fog will clear and it will be sunny.
Great. We can walk together on Sunday.
Good idea. Bring your umbrella, just in case.
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 혹시 모르니 우산 가져오세요.
